sequences.name: sandcastle-tooling
sequences.notes: All three edit packages/sandcastle/src/queue/ but on distinct files: #38 queue/manifest.ts (version-tolerant read), #33 queue/commands.ts + queue/ops.ts + main.ts + cli.ts (injected context), #60 queue/graph.ts + queue/render.ts (parallel lanes). In-batch order is #38 -> #33 -> #60 because #33 rewrites the two modules every subcommand flows through, and #60's graph render must go through the context #33 introduces rather than re-deriving it. No shared file, so no R-rule is needed against the other batches except where noted.
sequences.title: sandcastle: queue tooling
